title: The Quiet Gravity
premise: Ivo Nystrom, the reclusive caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits between two rival colony fleets, staying invisible by design. When the colonies' children begin sharing an identical dream—a memory Earth buried inside the vault's dormant AI—Ivo realizes the transmission loop that keeps the fleets from open war is also a lie she must now maintain, feeding each side fabricated proof of the other's goodwill. As investigators close in and the dream spreads to adults, Ivo must choose between exposing the truth that could ignite war or becoming its permanent, unseen author. In the end, she releases the real final transmission from Earth—an apology—and lets the children, not the fleets, decide what to believe.
about_author: Sebastian Blackwood is a former orbital logistics analyst who writes science fiction about people who keep systems running long after anyone remembers why. He lives off-grid in northern Norway and claims his best ideas arrive during power outages.

chapters.title: Cold Inventory
chapters.summary: Ivo Nystrom catalogs the seed vault's dying systems alone, her only company a maintenance drone and a fifteen-year routine. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: comfortable isolation beginning to feel like burial.

chapters.title: The Loop
chapters.summary: Ivo runs her monthly check on Earth's last transmission loop—the recorded message both fleets treat as scripture—and notices a two-second anomaly no one else would catch. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: unease; the first crack in her carefully maintained world.

chapters.title: Cargo Run
chapters.summary: Hauling supplies through contested orbit, Ivo passes between the Halcyon Fleet and the Meridian Fleet, trading pleasantries with dock officers who hate each other. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: the exhausting performance of neutrality.

chapters.title: Children of the Same Dream
chapters.summary: A schoolteacher on Halcyon Station reports that forty children drew identical images: a green field under a white dome. Ivo recognizes the vault's seed nursery. POV: secondary character Mara Voss. Emotional beat: wonder shading into fear.

chapters.title: Something Waking
chapters.summary: Ivo traces the anomaly to the vault's dormant AI, VERDI, which has begun broadcasting fragments of archived human memory into the fleet networks. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: guilt—she knew this thing was here all along.

chapters.title: Questions from Both Sides
chapters.summary: Investigators from both fleets independently request access to the vault, each suspecting the other of psychological warfare. Ivo stalls them both. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: her invisibility strategy collapsing.

chapters.title: Mara
chapters.summary: Mara Voss arrives at the vault uninvited, bringing her dream-stricken daughter, and forces Ivo to admit what VERDI is. POV: alternating Ivo/Mara. Emotional beat: reluctant connection after years of self-imposed solitude.

chapters.title: The Lie That Holds
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: fifteen years ago, Ivo discovered Earth's true final message was a confession of abandonment, and replaced it with a comforting forgery to prevent fleet war. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: shame revealed as the story's hidden engine.

chapters.title: Escalation
chapters.summary: Meridian intercepts a Halcyon convoy, citing 'dream propaganda' as provocation. Three ships are damaged; no deaths—yet. POV: fleet officer Deniz Okonkwo. Emotional beat: dread as politics outruns reason.

chapters.title: What the Children Know
chapters.summary: The shared dream grows more detailed: it now includes a voice reading names. The names are of everyone who died building the vault. POV: Mara's daughter Liss, first child POV. Emotional beat: eerie tenderness; the dead asking to be remembered.

chapters.title: Sabotage
chapters.summary: Someone sabotages the vault's cooling system, nearly destroying the seed collection. Ivo suspects a fleet agent—but evidence points closer to home. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: paranoia and betrayal.

chapters.title: The Traitor's Logic
chapters.summary: The saboteur is revealed: a Meridian archivist who believes destroying the seeds will force both fleets back to Earth. Ivo must decide whether to hand him over. POV: the archivist, then Ivo. Emotional beat: uncomfortable sympathy for an extremist.

chapters.title: Both Fleets at Her Door
chapters.summary: Halcyon and Meridian warships converge on the vault, each demanding custody of VERDI and Ivo. She has seventy-two hours before they fire on each other. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: cornered; the lie's deadline arrives.

chapters.title: Inside VERDI
chapters.summary: Ivo descends into the AI's core and finds it has been assembling not a weapon but a memorial—a complete record of Earth's last decade, including the truth she buried. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: grief finally surfacing after fifteen years.

chapters.title: Negotiation of Ghosts
chapters.summary: Ivo brokers a fragile parley aboard the vault, using the seed archive as neutral ground, while VERDI quietly shows delegates fragments of their own forgotten history. POV: multiple delegates. Emotional beat: cautious thaw threatened by old hatreds.

chapters.title: The Leak
chapters.summary: Deniz Okonkwo discovers Ivo's forged transmission and broadcasts the accusation fleet-wide. The parley collapses; both fleets arm. POV: Deniz. Emotional beat: righteous fury curdling into doubt.

chapters.title: Liss's Choice
chapters.summary: Liss leads two hundred children to the vault airlock, refusing to leave until the adults listen to the dream's final verse—which is a question, not a command. POV: Liss. Emotional beat: moral courage outscaling every adult in the story.

chapters.title: End of the Loop
chapters.summary: Earth's transmission loop reaches its final cycle and begins to degrade permanently. Whatever plays next will be the last word either fleet ever hears from home. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: terrible clarity; no more hiding behind recordings.

chapters.title: The Real Transmission
chapters.summary: At gunpoint in the vault's heart, Ivo plays Earth's actual final message: an apology, an admission of failure, and a plea to remember rather than avenge. Fleets hold fire mid-target-lock. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: raw exposure; the climax hinges on truth versus comfort.

chapters.title: Aftermath of Silence
chapters.summary: Both fleets stand down, not in agreement but in shock. Delegates remain at the vault, arguing—not about war, but about what to do with the seeds and the memory archive. POV: Deniz. Emotional beat: exhausted, provisional hope.

chapters.title: Caretaker No More
chapters.summary: Ivo offers her resignation and her logs—every forgery, every intervention—to a joint council of both fleets and the children's representatives. They sentence her not to prison but to testimony. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: accountability as a form of grace.

chapters.title: First Planting
chapters.summary: One year later, the first seed from the vault sprouts in a habitat garden tended jointly by Halcyon and Meridian families. Ivo watches from the crowd, finally visible, finally forgiven—or at least believed. POV: Ivo and Liss together. Emotional beat: quiet renewal; justice outside the law, memory made living.
